correctness.rationale: In a signed full binary tree each internal node is canonically assigned to a gap between its left/right leaf subtrees, whose two subtree sizes L_k,R_k count exactly the cross-subtree pairs. A pair is inverted iff its lowest common ancestor is negatively signed. Since random leaf splits do not inspect signs, B_k are iid Bernoulli(q), independent of unsigned tree, and I_n=sum B_k L_kR_k. Yule uniform-leaf splits induce the uniform-root-split BST recursion; independent priorities for all n-1 gaps generate it. Given priority U_k=t, nearest smaller priorities on each side give independent geometric tails, and E[L_kR_k|t]=(1-(1-t)^k)(1-(1-t)^(n-k))/t^2. Integrating yields w_nk=nH_{n-1}-kH_{k-1}-(n-k)H_{n-k-1}-1, including w_2,1=1. Differences w_(k+1)-w_k=H_(n-k-1)-H_k yield symmetry/strict concavity, hence strict log-concavity and increasing peak thresholds. Since P_i=(1-B_(i-1))*B_i, independence gives Cov(I,P_i)=pq*(p*w_i-q*w_(i-1)). Sum w=binom(n,2) gives E[I|D=d]=nd/2; harmonic asymptotic gives w_(floor alpha n)/n->binary entropy, fixed k gives k log n+O(1); so first and last peak thresholds ->1/3,2/3 while bulk ->1/2. All boundary n and peak ranges checked, no finite enumeration substituted for general proof.

originality.rationale: Féray--Rivera-Lopez define precisely this recursive model, signed tree, full point probabilities and total-descent Bernoulli distribution; these are treated as prior. The new evaluated L_kR_k positional kernel, full descent-vector inversion regression and ordered peak thresholds are not stated or implied without a nontrivial BST priority calculation. Chen--Kitaev--Zhang work is for uniform separable measure, not this recursive biased law. Resultary nearby uniform permutation inversion/cycle-covariance results are different.
residual_risks: The complete point-probability formula in the source implicitly determines all finite statistical expectations; a previous independent simplification of the same positional weighted sum could exist.
No uniform permutation sampling claim, no higher moments or full inversion conditional distribution beyond mean.

value.rationale: The exact influence of a local descent on global inversions is nonuniform: logarithmic near edges, order n with binary entropy envelope in bulk. Combined with the ordered peak-covariance sign transitions, this is a natural complete local-global statistic dependence classification for a nonuniform recursive separable permutation measure, beyond mere known binomial total descents.

limitations: Recursive uniform-leaf inflation with fixed 0<p<1, not uniform separable permutation measure; peak interior positions only; asymptotics at fixed edge offset or fixed alpha; no higher conditional moments.
